title: The typical size of Hecke eigenvalue sums is $o(\sqrt{x})$
summary: Let $\mathcal{H}_k$ denote the set of normalized holomorphic Hecke cusp forms of weight $k$ for the full modular group $ \mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb Z)$. For each $f\in\mathcal{H}_k$, let $λ_f(n)$ denote the corresponding eigenvalue of the normalized Hecke operator $T_n$. We prove nontrivial upper bounds for \[\sum_{f \in \mathcal{H}_k}ω_f \left|\sum_{n \leq x} λ_f(n)\right|^{2q},\] where $k$ is a positive even integer, $1\leqslant x\leqslant k$, $0\leqslant q \leqslant 1$ and $ ω_f = \frac{Γ(k-1)} {(4π)^{k-1}\langle f,f\rangle} = \frac{2π^2} {(k-1)L(1,\mathrm{Sym}^2 f)}. $ Our estimates match the…
